Title: Users may be unable to access or manage Microsoft Teams channels

User impact: Users may be unable to access or manage Microsoft Teams channels.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with accessing and managing Microsoft Teams channels and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Users may be unable to access or manage Microsoft Teams channels

User impact: Users may be unable to access or manage Microsoft Teams channels.

Current status: We've identified a series of 500 and 503 error codes originating from specific APIs that are required for channel management. We're investigating these error codes to understand the manifestation of the issue.

Scope of impact: This issue may impact any user in North America who is attempting to interact with Microsoft Teams channels. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Start time: Thursday, August 27, 2026, at 7:22 PM UTC

Next update by: Thursday, August 27, 2026, at 9:30 PM UTC

Title: Users may be unable to access or manage Microsoft Teams channels

User impact: Users may be unable to access or manage Microsoft Teams channels.

Current status: We've identified a large number of requests which are creating heavy load on service infrastructure that's responsible for processing user channel membership information. We're making a change to the way these process calls are handled to rebalance load across service infrastructure, which we expect will remediate impact.

Scope of impact: This issue may impact any user in North America who is attempting to interact with Microsoft Teams channels. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Root cause: A large number of user channel membership requests made to an API that handles Microsoft Teams channel information created a heavy load on service infrastructure, resulting in users in North America not being able to access or manage channels.

Next update by: Thursday, August 27, 2026, at 11:30 PM UTC

Title: Users may be unable to access or manage Microsoft Teams channels

Title: Users may be unable to access or manage some Microsoft Teams channels features

User impact: Users may be unable to access or manage some Microsoft Teams channels features.

More info: The currently impacted features include, but are not limited to:
- Viewing shared and private channel membership in the Microsoft Teams Admin Center
- Viewing shared and private channel membership in Microsoft Teams apps

Current status: We've updated the title, user impact, and scope of impact fields to reflect that we've confirmed that the majority of features related to Microsoft Teams channel access and management have recovered. However, our monitoring indicates that features related to user channel membership are still impacted due to the ongoing processing of the requests made to the managing API. We're continuing to analyze the reliability of this feature to determine if expediting remediation will be feasible.

Scope of impact: This issue may impact any user in North America who is attempting to interact with some features of Microsoft Teams channels. This information may be updated as our investigation continues.

Start time: Thursday, August 27, 2026, at 7:22 PM UTC

Root cause: A large number of user channel membership requests made to an API that handles Microsoft Teams channel information created a heavy load on service infrastructure, resulting in users in North America not being able to access or manage channels.

Next update by: Friday, August 28, 2026, at 4:30 AM UTC

Title: Users may be unable to access or manage some Microsoft Teams channels features

User impact: Users may have been unable to access or manage some Microsoft Teams channels features.

More info: Impacted features included viewing shared and private channel membership in the Microsoft Teams admin center and Microsoft Teams apps.

Final status: We disabled the affected request processing components to prevent additional requests from entering the backlog and allow our initial mitigative action to complete. We’ve confirmed through service monitoring that the backlog has cleared and the issue is resolved.

Scope of impact: This issue impacted some users in North America who attempted to access or manage Microsoft Teams channel membership features.

Start time: Thursday, August 27, 2026, at 7:22 PM UTC

End time: Friday, August 28, 2026, at 3:10 AM UTC

Root cause: A processing delay caused requests to exceed the retry timeout and enter a queue before earlier requests had completed. This created a large backlog of failed events and prevented users from accessing or managing some Microsoft Teams channel features.

Next steps: - We’re continuing our investigation to determine the underlying cause of the offending processing delays to better detect and prevent issues like this from occurring in the future.

This is the final update for the event.
